parsed.text: This packet contains fallible 4x4 location distributions for red and blue roles at nodes n0–n3 in two panels (p0, p1). Panel-level current records (view=current) are copied prior snapshots and are not new estimates; candidate records (view=candidate, commands k0/k1/k2) are conditional alternatives, not events that have occurred. In both panels the current distributions: n0 — blue peaks at cells (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3); red peaks at (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1). n1 and n2 are uniform across the grid. n3 — blue peaks at (1,1); red peaks at (0,2). Candidate command records show alternatives mainly for n0: k0 and k2 concentrate blue at (0,2) and red at (0,0); k1 also concentrates similarly but with different peak probabilities. Many candidate entries for n1 and n2 remain uniform. No propositions here assert physical presence, only which grid cells are maxima of the reported distributions.
